defect: relationOf scans all descendant replyingTo/marker text and headings, including nested quoted content. A main timeline card that quotes another user's reply can therefore be mislabeled as a reply itself; a quoted 'Discover more' heading can also falsely classify subsequent cards as related. Separately, every socialContext string was passed as repost even when it denotes a pin or comes from a nested quote.
decision: Bind a reply marker to the current top-level article's own rendered content, excluding recognized nested quote containers and tweetText prose.
Use related-section headings only when rendered outside any tweet article, so quoted or authored text is not a section boundary.
Keep known main-post relation null, explicit reply/related facts, and the unknown fallback. Do not infer parentage from author identity, post prose, order alone, or a quote's relation.

Project repost context only when its own socialContext explicitly uses a recognized Korean, English or Japanese repost/retweet label. Pinned/liked/other context is not a repost. Parent's subsequent explicit integration decision preserves the X pin experience through a distinct pinned boolean and separate frontend pin icon/label, not an interactive repost control; parent owns native type/API/UI changes.
No social mutation, URL/security/session changes, native build, source-page interactions, or unrelated production edits.
